name: Tuvalu
snapshot: One of the countries most threatened by rising seas, which signed a treaty letting its citizens move to Australia and is building a digital copy of itself.
culture: Tuvalu's nine low islands have close-knit communities organised around the falekaupule, a traditional assembly. Fatele, a dance with song and percussion on wooden boxes, marks celebrations. The country earns money from its ".tv" internet domain.
society: Tuvalu's highest point is about 4.6 metres above sea level. The Falepili treaty with Australia, in force since 2024, offers a pathway for up to 280 Tuvaluans a year to move there, and thousands applied in the first ballot. Tuvalu is creating a digital twin of its islands and culture in case the land is lost.
baseline: Feleti Teo became prime minister in 2024. Tuvalu remains one of the few countries to recognise Taiwan.

leaders.state: King Charles III, represented by a governor-general
